name: repo-platform-add-module
description: Add or remove a repo-platform module in a managed repository: edit the registration, merge it, run the sync for the module files, and finish the companion steps.

interface.shortDescription: Change a managed repository's repo-platform module selection.
interface.longDescription: The playbook for module changes in a repo-platform managed repository: the modules list and the module keys in .repo-platform.yml, the sync dispatch that writes the module files in a reported PR, which files each module brings, each module companion steps (labels, secrets, one-time setup), and what removal retires vs leaves behind.
